name: Custom Registration Fields for WooCommerce
author: Dickens Ayieko

sections.description:
Easily extend WooCommerce and WordPress user registration forms by adding custom fields to capture detailed information from your users.

This plugin supports up to 14 customizable field types, including:
– Text
– Textarea
– Email
– Number
– Password
– URL
– Telephone
– Date
– Time
– State
– Country
– Dropdown
– Radio Buttons
– Checkboxes
– File Uploads

For enhanced security, administrators can activate Google reCAPTCHA on both WooCommerce My Account and WordPress registration forms.

Enjoy complete flexibility to create unlimited custom fields. Each field can be tailored with options like:
– Label text
– Field width (full or half)
– Descriptive note

Note: The WooCommerce plugin must be installed to use this feature.

External Services

This plugin includes optional integration with Google reCAPTCHA. Google reCAPTCHA helps protect your forms from spam and brute force attacks. Enabling this feature enhances the security of your forms but is not mandatory.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the plugin settings page to configure custom fields and enable Google reCAPTCHA if needed.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce installed for this plugin to work?

Yes, WooCommerce is required to use this plugin.

Can I use this plugin without enabling Google reCAPTCHA?

Yes, Google reCAPTCHA is optional and can be enabled for additional security.

What types of custom fields are supported?

The plugin supports 14 types of fields, including text, email, number, dropdowns, and more.
